answer: Temporal Behavioral Divergence Analysis. The system tracks interaction graphs over time, flagging clusters where sub-identities share identical communication rhythms before a market shift. When a coordinated trading spiral emerges among low-cost nodes, the network isolates the cluster. The rising tide of correlated actions exposes shared control infrastructure without needing pre-registration checks. An attacker pays an isolation penalty: every fraudulent thread gets retroactively pruned, forfeiting accumulated routing rewards and locking internal capital for seven epochs.
